description: Points durs du réseau cyclable de la CALN is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Lisieux Normandie. Point data layer containing hard points (hazardous locations) present on the CALN cycling network. Date given: 2022. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Lisieux Normandie. The portal shows the English title as "Hard points of the CALN cycling network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Lisieux Normandie. Its keywords include featureserver, cyclable-points-durs, opendata, mobilite, geospatial. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WEB PAGE, ZIP, GEOJSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
